failures.root_cause: sw-cleanup.sh stale heartbeat detection and summary output (Found count + --force hint) not working in dry-run mode
failures.fix: Fix sw-cleanup.sh to detect stale heartbeat files in dry-run mode and output 'Found N item(s)' summary with '--force' hint when items are found

failures.root_cause: sed command references TEST_TEMP_DIR variable that was not expanded before being passed as the sed script argument, causing sed to treat the literal string as a file path
failures.fix: ensure TEST_TEMP_DIR is exported or properly quoted so it expands inside the sed expression, or use a different substitution approach

failures.root_cause: sed command attempts to read a file path instead of using inline expression — missing -e flag or improper quoting causes the substitution pattern to be treated as a filename
failures.fix: Fix the sed invocation in the test to use 'sed -e s|pattern|replacement|g' or use a here-string/pipe instead of treating the expression as a file argument

failures.root_cause: sw-cost-test.sh fails because cost dashboard CONTEXT EFFICIENCY section requires event data but no loop.context_efficiency events exist in the test environment
failures.fix: Seed mock loop.context_efficiency events in the test setup before running the dashboard rendering assertions
